content.json:
# Azure SQL POC observation workbook
Select the destination Log Analytics workspace and UTC time range. Panels require the corresponding telemetry tables and diagnostic exports. No data means not demonstrated, not healthy. Use the KQL discovery queries before importing. This is not a pricing or deployment template.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.query: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project id, name

content.title: SQL resource pressure — exported maximum %
content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider =~ 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where MetricName in ('cpu_percent','physical_data_read_percent','log_write_percent','workers_percent','sessions_percent')
| summarize Maximum=max(Maximum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), MetricName, ResourceId

content.title: Observed API p95 and represented failures
content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95), Requests=sum(ItemCount), Failures=sumif(ItemCount,Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m)
| extend ErrorPercent=100.0*Failures/Requests

content.title: ACA final outcomes — retry counts per request
content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Body=parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(Body.event) == 'operation_final'
| summarize FinalRequests=count(), RetriedRequests=countif(toint(Body.retry_count)>0) by TestRunId=tostring(Body.test_run_id)
| extend RetryPercent=100.0*RetriedRequests/FinalRequests
